description: Convert an amount from one currency to another — 250 GBP in JPY. Uses European Central Bank reference rates, and takes a past date back to 1999. Crypto converts at the live price through the dollar

date.description: Optional: the rate on a past day, as 2020-01-03. Currencies only, back to 1999

from.description: Currency or asset to convert from, as a code: GBP, USD, EUR, BTC…

to.description: Currency or asset to convert to, as a code: JPY, USD, ETH…

name: markets_convert
title: Convert markets
